method: angles: the interior angles of a simple quadrilateral add to 360; convex iff all < 180, concave iff exactly one > 180, any angle = 180 degenerates the figure; coordinates: turn directions (cross products) of consecutive edges, crossing test for AB/CD and BC/DA. Degenerate (collinear / 180 degree) cases are reported as Ambiguous (convention-dependent)

ambiguous.prompt: A closed path goes through four points A, B, C and D in order and back to A. The angles inside the path at the four points are ∠A = 55°, ∠B = 180°, ∠C = 65°, ∠D = 60°. What shape does the path make?
ambiguous.detail: an interior angle of exactly 180 degrees: the four points are not in general position (a triangle with an extra point on a side); "not a quadrilateral" (strict definition) vs a degenerate/weakly convex quadrilateral
